mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in >50% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by >0.3pp within the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in >50% of instances where INDPRO decreases by >0.5% within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.1% and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >40% of instances where PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions within the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates growing consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >60% of instances where RSAFS increases by >0.5% within the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show a decline, it signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both decrease by >0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in >40% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decrease by >0.5% within the next 60 trading days.
